comment: Baselines of the company apps. Counts and hashes only: no class names, no APK, no exploit detail (those live in the private review memos, outside the repository). Cards come from the Security scan section of a report; the sandbox report has no SCA cards and no AI triage, the device report has both: compare like with like (the `source` field).

wewallet.split: native libraries are in a separate config split (not scanned)
wewallet.protection: commercial obfuscator: 90% of classes renamed, string encryption in 65 classes, reflection marshalling in 1133 classes

axispay.split: native libraries (Flutter engine, Dart snapshot, protector) are in a separate config split (not scanned)
axispay.protection: 99% of classes renamed and repackaged into the root package; one static native method decrypts the strings (about 63,000 call sites)
axispay.hybrid: Flutter: the Dart code is not visible to this scanner
